source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 21 May 1955, p. 9 ("Londonderry: county council elections")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: named as the replacement for the retiring member in a division other than Coleraine, the only contested division (Mid-Ulster Mail, 21 May 1955; Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1955)

note: Polled 2 June 1955 (Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1955: 'Polling took place yesterday in elections for county and rural councils in Northern Ireland'). Coleraine was the only contest; the other eighteen members were returned unopposed, and are named in the Mid-Ulster Mail's report of 21 May 1955 (the Londonderry Sentinel of 19 May 1955 names the same list and the three replacements). Returned unopposed.
